        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
          AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
          AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
          AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
          AND (
                InvestmentStructureLevel3 IN ('Infrastructure','Real Estate','Sustainable Energy Group')
                  AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Dev Mkts - Infrastructure', 'Emerging Mkts - Infrastructure','Listed Real Estate','Power and Renewables Group')
                  AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Listed Infrastructure - DM', 'Listed Infrastructure - EM','Listed Real Estate DM', 'Listed Real Estate EM','Power Generation')
                  AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('RIRELCP')
                   OR model_portfolio IN ('MIN1000104','MPRSBE0', 'MPR1000279', 'MPR1000328', 'MPR1000200', 'MPAR100041')
                )
          AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) >= DATE('2024-04-01')
    ),
    latest_trans AS (
        SELECT trans.*, 
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                    PARTITION BY trans.abor_security_number, trans.scd_transaction_number_primary_key
                    ORDER BY trans.changed_date DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions trans
        WHERE trans.transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
        --  AND trans.requested_transaction_status = 'Final GL'
          AND trans.reconciliation_status = 'Reconcilable'
          AND trans.business_transaction_code in ('Sell','CASell','SellInternal','Buy','CABuy','BuyInternal','CapRed','Exchange Offer','Dividend','Rights Distribution','GenCost')
          AND CAST(trans.trade_date AS DATE) >= DATE('2024-04-01')
    ),
    latest_finance_trans AS (
        SELECT fin.*, 
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                    PARTITION BY fin.scd_finance_transaction_number_primary_key, fin.finance_transaction_index
                    ORDER BY fin.extract_time DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM finance_accounting.scd_finance_transactions fin
        WHERE fin.finance_scheme LIKE '%EQTY%'
          AND fin.accounting_framework_id = 'MAIN'
          AND fin.gl_account_name != 'CASH BALANCE'
          AND fin.gl_account_name NOT LIKE '%DUE%'
          AND fin.booking_type != 'Payment reconciliation'
    ),
    trans AS (
        SELECT
            trans.trade_date                        AS business_date,
            trans.model_portfolio_id                AS model_portfolio_id,
            sec.bloomberg_unique_id                 AS bb_unique_id,
            CASE
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Sell','SellInternal','CASell') AND fin.gl_account_name LIKE '%COST OF INVESTMENT%' THEN 'Sell ROC'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Sell','SellInternal','CASell') AND fin.gl_account_name LIKE '%TRNS BRKR COMM COST%' THEN 'Sell Costs'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Sell','SellInternal','CASell') AND fin.gl_account_name LIKE '%REALIZED%' THEN 'Sell GL'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Buy','BuyInternal','CABuy','Exchange Offer') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%COST OF INVESTMENT%' THEN 'Net Purchase'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Buy','BuyInternal','CABuy') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%TRNS BRKR COMM COST%' THEN 'Purchase Costs'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Dividend') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%DIVIDEND INC%' THEN 'Gross Dividend'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Dividend') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%TAX EXP%' THEN 'Dividend Taxes'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('CapRed') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%COST OF INVESTMENT%' THEN 'CapRd ROC'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('CapRed') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%REALIZED CURR GL%' THEN 'CapRd GL'
                ELSE 'unmapped'
            END                                     AS transaction_type,            
            fin.credit_amount_portfolio_currency-fin.debit_amount_portfolio_currency     AS total_amount_pc,
            fin.credit_amount_quotation_currency-fin.debit_amount_quotation_currency     AS total_amount_qc

                ON trans.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio

            WHERE trans.rn = 1
            AND fin.rn = 1

        SELECT business_date, bb_unique_id,model_portfolio_id,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell ROC' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_roc_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell Costs' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_cos_pc,

            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Net Purchase' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS net_purchase_qc,

            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'CapRd GL' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS cap_gl_qc
        FROM trans 
        WHERE transaction_type != 'unmapped'
        GROUP BY business_date, bb_unique_id,model_portfolio_id     
    ),
    calculated_trans AS(
        SELECT business_date, bb_unique_id,model_portfolio_id,
            net_purchase_pc + purchase_cost_pc AS gross_purchase_pc,
            sell_roc_pc + sell_cos_pc + sell_gl_pc AS net_sell_pc,

            net_purchase_qc + purchase_cost_qc AS gross_purchase_qc,
            sell_roc_qc + sell_cos_qc + sell_gl_qc AS net_sell_qc,
            cap_roc_qc + cap_gl_qc AS total_cap_qc,
            sell_roc_qc + sell_cos_qc + sell_gl_qc + net_purchase_qc + purchase_cost_qc + cap_roc_qc + cap_gl_qc AS net_cap_bal_qc
        FROM aggregated_trans

    performance AS(
        SELECT business_date,

       ON holding.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio_id
      AND holding.business_date = mp.business_date
LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers sec
       ON holding.cppib_sec_id = CAST(sec.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR)
      AND CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE) = sec.business_date

      AND CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE) = sec_ent.business_date

      AND CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE) = currency1.business_date

       ON sec_ent.cppib_country_of_exposure_code = country.country_code
      AND country.business_date = CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE)

       ON calc.bb_unique_id = sec.bloomberg_unique_id 
      AND calc.business_date = holding.business_date
      AND calc.model_portfolio_id = holding.model_portfolio_id
LEFT JOIN performance perf
       ON holding.model_portfolio_id = perf.model_portfolio_id
      AND holding.abor_security_id = perf.abor_security_id
      AND holding.business_date = perf.business_date

         sec.bloomberg_unique_id) AS "Holdings"

            net_purchase_qc + purchase_cost_qc AS gross_purchase_qc,
            sell_roc_qc + sell_cos_qc + sell_gl_qc AS net_sell_qc,
            cap_roc_qc + cap_gl_qc AS total_cap_qc,
            sell_roc_qc + sell_cos_qc + sell_gl_qc + net_purchase_qc + purchase_cost_qc + cap_roc_qc + cap_gl_qc AS net_cap_bal_qc
        FROM aggregated_trans
    ),
    performance AS(
        SELECT business_date,
            model_portfolio_id,
            abor_security_id,
            cash_flow_reporting_currency,
            cash_flow_quotation_currency,
            clean_price,
            payments_quotation_currency,
            payments_reporting_currency,
            reallocation_payments_quotation_currency,
            reallocation_payments_reporting_currency,
            nominal_value_buy_sell_during_the_day
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation
    )

SELECT
    CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE)                                              AS "Business Date",
    regional_classification_name                                                     AS "DM/EM",
    sec_ent.cppib_sector_classification_name_4                                       AS "Sector",
    holding.abor_security_id                                                         AS "Ticker",
    holding.balance_nominal_number                                                   AS "Share Owned",
    holding.balance_cost_value_quotation_currency                                    AS "Cost QC",
    holding.balance_cost_value_portfolio_currency                                    AS "Cost PC",  
    holding.unrealised_pnl_book_value_quotation_currency                             AS "ITD Unrealized PnL QC",                                    
    sec.bloomberg_unique_id                                                          AS "BB Unique ID",
    TRIM(REPLACE(sec.bloomberg_cd, sec.sec_typ_lvl1_nm, ''))                         AS "Bloomberg Code",
    mp.model_portfolio_name                                                          AS "Model Portfolio Name",
    mp.model_portfolio_id                                                            AS "Model Portfolio Code",
    sec.sec_nm                                                                       AS "Security Name",
    holding.quotation_currency_code                                                  AS "Quoted Currency",
    country.country_name                                                             AS "Country",
    holding.balance_nominal_number                                                   AS "Balance Nominal/Number",
    holding.dirty_value_total_quotation_currency                                     AS "Total Market Value QC",
    holding.dirty_value_total_portfolio_currency                                     AS "Total Market Value PC",
    perf.clean_price                                                                 AS "Clean Price",
    perf.nominal_value_buy_sell_during_the_day                                       AS "Size",
    perf.cash_flow_reporting_currency                                                AS "Cash Flow PC",
    perf.cash_flow_quotation_currency                                                AS "Cash Flow QC",
    perf.payments_quotation_currency,
    perf.payments_reporting_currency,
    perf.reallocation_payments_quotation_currency,
    perf.reallocation_payments_reporting_currency,
    calc.gross_purchase_pc                                                           AS "Gross Purchase PC",
    calc.net_sell_pc                                                                 AS "Net Sell PC",
    calc.total_cap_pc                                                                AS "Total Capital PC",
    COALESCE(calc.net_cap_bal_pc,0)                                                  AS "Net Capital Balance PC",
    calc.gross_purchase_qc                                                           AS "Gross Purchase QC",
    calc.net_sell_qc                                                                 AS "Net Sell QC",
    calc.total_cap_qc                                                                AS "Total Capital QC",
    COALESCE(calc.net_cap_bal_qc,0)                                                  AS "Net Capital Balance QC"
FROM holdings.scd_holdings_main holding
INNER JOIN listed_ra_mp invstr
        ON holding.model_portfolio_id = invstr.model_portfolio
       AND holding.business_date = invstr.business_date
LEFT JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio mp
       ON holding.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio_id
      AND holding.business_date = mp.business_date
LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers sec
       ON holding.cppib_sec_id = CAST(sec.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR)
      AND CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE) = sec.business_date
LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications sec_ent
       ON holding.cppib_sec_id = CAST(sec_ent.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR)
      AND CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE) = sec_ent.business_date
LEFT JOIN reference.reference_currency_codes currency1
       ON holding.quotation_currency_code = currency1.currency_code
      AND CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE) = currency1.business_date
LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes country
       ON sec_ent.cppib_country_of_exposure_code = country.country_code
      AND country.business_date = CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE)
LEFT JOIN calculated_trans calc
       ON calc.bb_unique_id = sec.bloomberg_unique_id 
      AND calc.business_date = holding.business_date
      AND calc.model_portfolio_id = holding.model_portfolio_id
LEFT JOIN performance perf
       ON holding.model_portfolio_id = perf.model_portfolio_id
      AND holding.abor_security_id = perf.abor_security_id
      AND holding.business_date = perf.business_date
WHERE CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE) >= DATE('2024-04-01')
  AND holding.cppib_sec_id IS NOT NULL
  AND holding.abor_security_type_name IN ('Common Stock', 'Depository Receipt', 'PMI Deferred Tax Liability', 'Preferred Stock', 'REIT', 'Unit', 'Right')
ORDER BY holding.business_date DESC,
         sec.bloomberg_unique_id) AS "Holdings"
LIMIT 1000

) GROUP BY
	client_ip

SELECT ds.* FROM ( WITH
    listed_ra_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name,
            InvestmentStructureLevel5
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
          AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
          AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
          AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
          AND (
                InvestmentStructureLevel3 IN ('Infrastructure','Real Estate','Sustainable Energy Group')
                  AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Dev Mkts - Infrastructure', 'Emerging Mkts - Infrastructure','Listed Real Estate','Power and Renewables Group')
                  AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Listed Infrastructure - DM', 'Listed Infrastructure - EM','Listed Real Estate DM', 'Listed Real Estate EM','Power Generation')
                  AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('RIRELCP')
                   OR model_portfolio IN ('MIN1000104','MPRSBE0', 'MPR1000279', 'MPR1000328', 'MPR1000200', 'MPAR100041')
                )
          AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) >= DATE('2024-04-01')
    ),
    latest_trans AS (
        SELECT trans.*, 
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                    PARTITION BY trans.abor_security_number, trans.scd_transaction_number_primary_key
                    ORDER BY trans.changed_date DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions trans
        WHERE trans.transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
        --  AND trans.requested_transaction_status = 'Final GL'
          AND trans.reconciliation_status = 'Reconcilable'
          AND trans.business_transaction_code in ('Sell','CASell','SellInternal','Buy','CABuy','BuyInternal','CapRed','Exchange Offer','Dividend','Rights Distribution','GenCost')
          AND CAST(trans.trade_date AS DATE) >= DATE('2024-04-01')
    ),
    latest_finance_trans AS (
        SELECT fin.*, 
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                    PARTITION BY fin.scd_finance_transaction_number_primary_key, fin.finance_transaction_index
                    ORDER BY fin.extract_time DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM finance_accounting.scd_finance_transactions fin
        WHERE fin.finance_scheme LIKE '%EQTY%'
          AND fin.accounting_framework_id = 'MAIN'
          AND fin.gl_account_name != 'CASH BALANCE'
          AND fin.gl_account_name NOT LIKE '%DUE%'
          AND fin.booking_type != 'Payment reconciliation'
    ),
    trans AS (
        SELECT
            trans.trade_date                        AS business_date,
            trans.model_portfolio_id                AS model_portfolio_id,
            sec.bloomberg_unique_id                 AS bb_unique_id,
            CASE
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Sell','SellInternal','CASell') AND fin.gl_account_name LIKE '%COST OF INVESTMENT%' THEN 'Sell ROC'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Sell','SellInternal','CASell') AND fin.gl_account_name LIKE '%TRNS BRKR COMM COST%' THEN 'Sell Costs'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Sell','SellInternal','CASell') AND fin.gl_account_name LIKE '%REALIZED%' THEN 'Sell GL'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Buy','BuyInternal','CABuy','Exchange Offer') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%COST OF INVESTMENT%' THEN 'Net Purchase'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Buy','BuyInternal','CABuy') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%TRNS BRKR COMM COST%' THEN 'Purchase Costs'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Dividend') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%DIVIDEND INC%' THEN 'Gross Dividend'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Dividend') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%TAX EXP%' THEN 'Dividend Taxes'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('CapRed') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%COST OF INVESTMENT%' THEN 'CapRd ROC'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('CapRed') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%REALIZED CURR GL%' THEN 'CapRd GL'
                ELSE 'unmapped'
            END                                     AS transaction_type,            
            fin.credit_amount_portfolio_currency-fin.debit_amount_portfolio_currency     AS total_amount_pc,
            fin.credit_amount_quotation_currency-fin.debit_amount_quotation_currency     AS total_amount_qc
            FROM latest_trans trans
            INNER JOIN latest_finance_trans fin
                ON trans.scd_transaction_number_primary_key = fin.scd_finance_transaction_number_primary_key
            INNER JOIN listed_ra_mp mp
                ON trans.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
               AND trans.trade_date = mp.business_date
            LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers sec
               ON CAST(trans.trade_date AS DATE) = sec.business_date
              AND trans.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(sec.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))
            WHERE trans.rn = 1
            AND fin.rn = 1     
    ),
    aggregated_trans AS (
        SELECT business_date, bb_unique_id,model_portfolio_id,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell ROC' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_roc_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell Costs' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_cos_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell GL' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_gl_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Net Purchase' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS net_purchase_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Purchase Costs' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS purchase_cost_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'CapRd ROC' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS cap_roc_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'CapRd GL' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS cap_gl_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell ROC' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_roc_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell Costs' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_cos_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell GL' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_gl_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Net Purchase' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS net_purchase_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Purchase Costs' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS purchase_cost_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'CapRd ROC' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS cap_roc_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'CapRd GL' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS cap_gl_qc
        FROM trans 
        WHERE transaction_type != 'unmapped'
        GROUP BY business_date, bb_unique_id,model_portfolio_id     
    ),
    calculated_trans AS(
        SELECT business_date, bb_unique_id,model_portfolio_id,net_purchase_qc,purchase_cost_qc,
            net_purchase_pc + purchase_cost_pc AS gross_purchase_pc,
            sell_roc_pc + sell_cos_pc + sell_gl_pc AS net_sell_pc,
            cap_roc_pc + cap_gl_pc AS total_cap_pc,
            sell_roc_pc + sell_cos_pc + sell_gl_pc + net_purchase_pc + purchase_cost_pc + cap_roc_pc + cap_gl_pc AS net_cap_bal_pc,
            net_purchase_qc + purchase_cost_qc AS gross_purchase_qc,
            sell_roc_qc + sell_cos_qc + sell_gl_qc AS net_sell_qc,
            cap_roc_qc + cap_gl_qc AS total_cap_qc,
            sell_roc_qc + sell_cos_qc + sell_gl_qc + net_purchase_qc + purchase_cost_qc + cap_roc_qc + cap_gl_qc AS net_cap_bal_qc
        FROM aggregated_trans
    ),
    performance AS(
        SELECT business_date,
            model_portfolio_id,
            abor_security_id,
            cash_flow_reporting_currency,
            cash_flow_quotation_currency,
            clean_price,
            payments_quotation_currency,
            payments_reporting_currency,
            reallocation_payments_quotation_currency,
            reallocation_payments_reporting_currency,
            nominal_value_buy_sell_during_the_day
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation
    )

SELECT
    CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE)                                              AS "Business Date",
    regional_classification_name                                                     AS "DM/EM",
    sec_ent.cppib_sector_classification_name_4                                       AS "Sector",
    holding.abor_security_id                                                         AS "Ticker",
    holding.balance_nominal_number                                                   AS "Share Owned",
    holding.balance_cost_value_quotation_currency                                    AS "Cost QC",
    holding.balance_cost_value_portfolio_currency                                    AS "Cost PC",

    mp.model_portfolio_name                                                          AS "Model Portfolio Name",
    mp.model_portfolio_id                                                            AS "Model Portfolio Code",

    perf.cash_flow_quotation_currency                                                AS "Cash Flow QC",
    perf.payments_quotation_currency,
    perf.payments_reporting_currency,
    perf.reallocation_payments_quotation_currency,
    perf.reallocation_payments_reporting_currency,
    calc.net_purchase_qc                                                             AS "Net Purchase QC",
    calc.purchase_cost_qc                                                            AS "Purchase Cost QC",
    calc.gross_purchase_pc                                                           AS "Gross Purchase PC",
    calc.net_sell_pc                                                                 AS "Net Sell PC",
    calc.total_cap_pc                                                                AS "Total Capital PC",
    COALESCE(calc.net_cap_bal_pc,0)                                                  AS "Net Capital Balance PC",
    calc.gross_purchase_qc                                                           AS "Gross Purchase QC",

    COALESCE(calc.net_cap_bal_qc,0)                                                  AS "Net Capital Balance QC"
FROM holdings.scd_holdings_main holding

        ON holding.model_portfolio_id = invstr.model_portfolio
       AND holding.business_date = invstr.business_date
LEFT JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio mp
       ON holding.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio_id
      AND holding.business_date = mp.business_date
LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers sec
       ON holding.cppib_sec_id = CAST(sec.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR)
      AND CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE) = sec.business_date
LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications sec_ent
       ON holding.cppib_sec_id = CAST(sec_ent.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR)
      AND CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE) = sec_ent.business_date
LEFT JOIN reference.reference_currency_codes currency1
       ON holding.quotation_currency_code = currency1.currency_code
      AND CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE) = currency1.business_date
LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes country
       ON sec_ent.cppib_country_of_exposure_code = country.country_code
      AND country.business_date = CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE)
LEFT JOIN calculated_trans calc
       ON calc.bb_unique_id = sec.bloomberg_unique_id 
      AND calc.business_date = holding.business_date
      AND calc.model_portfolio_id = holding.model_portfolio_id
LEFT JOIN performance perf
       ON holding.model_portfolio_id = perf.model_portfolio_id
      AND holding.abor_security_id = perf.abor_security_id
      AND holding.business_date = perf.business_date
WHERE CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE) >= DATE('2024-04-01')
  AND holding.cppib_sec_id IS NOT NULL
  AND holding.abor_security_type_name IN ('Common Stock', 'Depository Receipt', 'PMI Deferred Tax Liability', 'Preferred Stock', 'REIT', 'Unit', 'Right')
ORDER BY holding.business_date DESC,
         sec.bloomberg_unique_id ) ds LIMIT 0

SELECT "dataset_id", "business_date", "pbor_node_name", "split_level", "metric_type", "currency", "period", "value", "business_date_string", "period_sorted"

	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, cast( business_date as date ) as business_date
		, case 
			when dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) and split_level = 0 then 'Total Fund'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Base CPP'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Additional CPP'
			when dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF', 'ATP_TF_D' ) and split_level = 1 then 'Total Fund Benchmark Portfolio'
		  	else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  scd.dataset_id 
			, scd.business_date 
			, scd.pbor_node_name 
			, scd.split_level 
			-- for below, TOTALFUND local values should be not used; CMBP_NET CAD values should not be used
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency end time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency

			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_reporting_currency end pnl_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_local_currency end pnl_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_local_currency end pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update

			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd
		left join (
			/* perf_bottom_up_monthly:
			 * - Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id

					dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND_D' )
					and "level" = 0
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP_D', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP_D' )
					and "level" = 0 
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
			/* perf_top_down_monthly:
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			union all
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date

				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, pnl_4yp_lc
			from
				performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
			where 
				periods_per_year = 365
				and dataset_id = 'ATP_TF_D'
		) perf
		on
			scd.business_date = cast( perf.business_date as varchar )
			and scd.dataset_id = perf.dataset_id
			and scd.pbor_node_name = perf.node_name
			and scd.split_level = perf."level"
		where 
			scd.periods_per_year = '365'
			and (
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 0

        FROM (
		    SELECT
		        currencyCode,
			    date,
			    MAX(currencyToUsdRate) OVER (
				    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
				    grouped_usd,
				    data_diff
			    ) as currencyToUsdRate,
                MAX(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
                    grouped_cad,
                    data_diff
                ) as currencyToCadRate
			FROM (
				SELECT date,
					currencyCode,
					currencyToCadRate,
					currencyToUsdRate,
					COUNT(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as grouped_cad,
					COUNT(currencyToUsdRate) OVER (
						PARTITION BY currencyCode

SELECT "dataset_id", "business_date", "pbor_node_name", "split_level", "metric_type", "currency", "period", "value", "business_date_string", "period_sorted"
FROM (with scd_perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, cast( business_date as date ) as business_date
		, case 
			when dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) and split_level = 0 then 'Total Fund'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Base CPP'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Additional CPP'
			when dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF', 'ATP_TF_D' ) and split_level = 1 then 'Total Fund Benchmark Portfolio'
		  	else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  scd.dataset_id 
			, scd.business_date 
			, scd.pbor_node_name 
			, scd.split_level 
			-- for below, TOTALFUND local values should be not used; CMBP_NET CAD values should not be used
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency end time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_reporting_currency end pnl_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_local_currency end pnl_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_local_currency end pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update
		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:
			 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd
		left join (
			/* perf_bottom_up_monthly:
			 * - Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_lc end time_weighted_return_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else pnl_4yp_lc end pnl_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
			from
				performance.perf_bottom_up_monthly 
			where 
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND_D' )
					and "level" = 0
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP_D', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP_D' )
					and "level" = 0 
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
			/* perf_top_down_monthly:
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			union all
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, pnl_4yp_lc
			from
				performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
			where 
				periods_per_year = 365
				and dataset_id = 'ATP_TF_D'
		) perf
		on
			scd.business_date = cast( perf.business_date as varchar )
			and scd.dataset_id = perf.dataset_id
			and scd.pbor_node_name = perf.node_name
			and scd.split_level = perf."level"
		where 
			scd.periods_per_year = '365'
			and (
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 0
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' )
					and scd.split_level = 0 
				)
				/* BENCHMARK PORTFOLIO */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF' )
					and scd.split_level = 1
				)
				/* DEPARTMENTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 2
					and scd.pbor_parent_node_id = 2
				)
			)
	) scd_perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) scd_perf_unpivot ( metric, value )
), perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) Total Fund: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, business_date
		, case
			when dataset_id = 'ATP_BCPP_D' then 'Base CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
			when dataset_id = 'ATP_ACPP_D' then 'Additional CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_TF_D' then 'Total Fund Value-Added'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' then 'Base CPP Value-Added'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD' then 'Additional CPP Value-Added'
			else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  dataset_id
			, business_date
			, node_name as pbor_node_name
			, "level" as split_level
			, time_weighted_return_rc as time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_lc as time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc as time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc as time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc as time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc as time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc as time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc as time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_rc as pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_lc as pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_qtd_rc as pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_qtd_lc as pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fytd_rc as pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fytd_lc as pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5y_roll_rc as pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5y_roll_lc as pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		from
			performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where 
			dataset_id in ( 'ATP_BCPP_D', 'ATP_ACPP_D', 'INV_SELECT_TF_D', 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD', 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' )
			and "level" = 1
	) perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) perf_unpivot ( metric, value )
), cmb as (
	select * from scd_perf
	union all
	select * from perf
), cmb_clean as (
	select
		cmb.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, case
			when period = '1D' then '1. 1-Day'
			when period = 'MTD' then '2. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '3. QTD'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '5. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '6. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted
	from
		cmb
	where
		value is not null
		and business_date >= cast( '2019-04-01' as date )
		and not ( pbor_node_name in ( 'Active Equities', 'Capital Markets & Factor Investing' ) and metric_type = 'Return' )
)

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency

			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:

			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency

			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update

			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:

			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y

			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd

				, pnl_4yp_rc

			/* perf_top_down_monthly:

				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc

			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency

		from
			performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where 
			dataset_id in ( 'ATP_BCPP_D', 'ATP_ACPP_D', 'INV_SELECT_TF_D', 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD', 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' )

	) perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[

			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'

			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'

		/* VALUE */

			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency

			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency

			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y

/* cppi::6747fa4e20bbe972334c53add0d8beb96e7a25b9281d2d2712cb21f59487c65e */
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( 
    -- Get latest business date data that is available in both tables
    WITH max_business_date AS (
        SELECT MAX( business_date ) business_date
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten i
        WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM finance_accounting.ssd_model_portfolio m
            WHERE DATE( i.business_date ) = m.business_date
            -- business_date field in scd_performance_invstr_flatten is a string
            )
    ),
    -- Get the latest investment structure name that starts with 'CPPIB_F'.  As of 2025-04-25, the latest is CPPIB_F24
    latest_investment_structure AS (
        SELECT MAX( InvestmentStructure ) latest_investment_structure_name
        FROM max_business_date d
        JOIN performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten i
            ON i.business_date = d.business_date
            AND InvestmentStructure LIKE 'CPPIB_F%%'
    )
    SELECT 
        i.model_portfolio model_portfolio_code,
        i.model_portfolio_name,
        investmentstructurelevel1 investment_structure_level_01,
        investmentstructurelevel2 investment_structure_level_02,
        investmentstructurelevel3 investment_structure_level_03,
        investmentstructurelevel4 investment_structure_level_04,
        investmentstructurelevel5 investment_structure_level_05,
        investmentstructurelevel6 investment_structure_level_06,
        investmentstructurelevel7 investment_structure_level_07,
        pool_cpp_account_code_code core_supp,
        investment_strategy_name,
        investmentstructure investment_structure_name
    FROM max_business_date d
    JOIN latest_investment_structure l on 1 = 1
    JOIN performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten i
        ON i.business_date = d.business_date
        AND investmentstructure = l.latest_investment_structure_name
    LEFT JOIN finance_accounting.ssd_model_portfolio m
        ON m.business_date = DATE( d.business_date )
        AND m.id_model_portfolio = i.model_portfolio
 ) t

           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY scd_transaction_number_primary_key
						order by
							changed_date desc -- change date is actual loaded date so use this to get the latest data.
           ) AS rn
    FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions
    WHERE accounting_framework_id = 'PCLFWKMAIN'
),
JoinedData AS (
    SELECT 
        st.scd_transaction_number_primary_key,
        CAST(st.business_date AS DATE) AS business_date,
        ROUND(st.abor_transaction_number) AS abor_transaction_number,

        st.additional_payable_amount_quotation_currency,
        st.ibor_reason,
        st.dividend_per_share,
        st.borrowing_account,
        st.rn,
        CASE 
            WHEN ss.abor_security_type_id IN ('FXFORWARD','FXNDF','FXSPOT') AND st.abor_security_name LIKE '%CAD%' THEN 'Y'
            WHEN ss.abor_security_type_id IN ('FXFORWARD','FXNDF','FXSPOT') THEN 'N'

        es.isin,
        es.cusip,
        es.esm_incorp_country_code,

    LEFT JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio smp 
        ON smp.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio)

    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes rcc_exchange_country 
        ON es.esm_country_code = rcc_exchange_country.country_code
        AND rcc_exchange_country.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_country_codes)

        AND st.transaction_cancellation_flag = stc.transaction_cancellation_flag

/* cppi::ec87e2b4cc31595b43e59ff71d1b80ae3cc5f8c4ff8899290096c9b53f6af858 */
SELECT business_date,
       portfolio_group_id,
       mp.pool_account_code,
       bcpp_unitized_percentage,
       acpp_unitized_percentage,
       scd_unitization,
       CASE
           WHEN bcpp_unitized_percentage IS NOT NULL THEN (
               SUM(herbi.market_value_pc) * bcpp_unitized_percentage
               )
           END                    AS herbi_bcpp_core_supp_mv,
       CASE
           WHEN acpp_unitized_percentage IS NOT NULL THEN (
               SUM(herbi.market_value_pc) * acpp_unitized_percentage
               )
           END                    AS herbi_acpp_core_supp_mv,
       SUM(herbi.market_value_pc) AS herbi_total_market_value_pc,
       SUM(herbi.market_value_qc) AS herbi_total_market_value_qc
FROM (
         /* MAIN HOLDINGS */
         select mh.model_portfolio_id,
                mh.portfolio_group_id,
                sum(market_value_pc) market_value_pc,
                sum(market_value_qc) market_value_qc,
                business_date from 
        (
         SELECT mh.model_portfolio_id,
                mh.portfolio_group_id,
                mh.dirty_value_total_portfolio_currency AS market_value_pc,
                mh.dirty_value_total_quotation_currency AS market_value_qc,
                mh.business_date
         FROM holdings.scd_holdings_main mh
         WHERE mh.business_date = '2025-06-16'
           AND mh.portfolio_group_id IN ('CPPIB GROUP', 'SUPPLEMENTARY', 'ACPP', 'BCPP')
       ) mh
         GROUP BY mh.model_portfolio_id,
                  mh.portfolio_group_id,
                  mh.business_date
     ) herbi
/* MODEL PORTFOLIO FREECODES */
         LEFT JOIN (SELECT model_portfolio_id,
                           pool_account_code
                    FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio
                    WHERE business_date = '2025-06-16') mp
                   ON herbi.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio_id
/* UNITIZATION PERCENTAGE */
         LEFT JOIN (SELECT unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code,
                           market_value_portfolio_currency_amount AS scd_unitization,
                           SUM(
                                   CASE
                                       WHEN acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'ACPP' THEN unitized_percentage
                                       END
                           )                                      AS acpp_unitized_percentage,
                           SUM(
                                   CASE
                                       WHEN acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'BCPP' THEN unitized_percentage
                                       END
                           )                                      AS bcpp_unitized_percentage
                    FROM finance_accounting.scd_unitization
                    WHERE acpp_bcpp_account_code IN ('ACPP', 'BCPP')
                      AND business_date = '2025-06-16'
                    GROUP BY unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code,
                             market_value_portfolio_currency_amount) unitization
                   ON mp.pool_account_code = unitization.unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
GROUP BY business_date,
         portfolio_group_id,
         mp.pool_account_code,
         bcpp_unitized_percentage,
         acpp_unitized_percentage,
         scd_unitization

with asset_instrument_classification as
(
    select
      cast(cppib_sec_id as varchar) as id_holding_decomposition,
      'CPPIBSEC_ID' holding_decomposition_id_type_code,
      security_type_id as "Security type",
      security_type_name as "Security type name",
      business_date
    from cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_security_composite
    where business_date = date'2025-06-16'
    and esm_instrument_type = 'cppib_sec_id'
    and security_type_id is not null
),
asset_security_party_relationship as
(
    select
    cppib_sec_id,
    cppib_party_id,
    business_date
    from asset.asset_security_party_relationship
    where business_date = date'2025-06-16'
    and role = 'ISSUER'
),
party_enterprise_classification as
(
    select
    party_name as issuer_name,
    cppib_party_id,
    cppib_country_of_exposure_code,
    cppib_sector_classification_code_1 as gics_sector_code,
    business_date
    from party.party_enterprise_classification
    where business_date = date'2025-06-16'
),
party_ratings as
(
    select
    business_date,
    cppib_party_id, 
    rating_agency, 
    rating_value
    from risk_prod.cppib_party_rating
    where rating_agency='CPPIB' and 
    business_date = '2025-06-16'
),
reference_country_codes as
(
    select
    country_code,
    country_name as cppib_country_of_exposure,
    business_date
    from reference.reference_country_codes
    where business_date = date'2025-06-16'
)

select * from asset_instrument_classification
left join asset_security_party_relationship
on cast(asset_security_party_relationship.cppib_sec_id as varchar) = asset_instrument_classification.id_holding_decomposition
left join party_enterprise_classification
on party_enterprise_classification.cppib_party_id = asset_security_party_relationship.cppib_party_id
left join party_ratings

/* cppi::8bacae6f81a9cd1a2c58731b154007399e49300baa191787f3b17be9a33d1773 */
/* QuickSight 2044d1df-e252-4b3c-9349-408d7dad3ef5 */
SELECT "business_date", "investment_structure_level_01", "investment_structure_level_02", "ultimate_parent_party_name", "issuer_name", "parent_security_type_name", "security_type_name", "security_name", "total_market_value_pc", "security_name_clean", "combined_entity_name_original", "combined_entity_name_clean", "department_sorted"
FROM (with lt_base as (
	select
		lt.business_date,
		spif.investmentstructurelevel1 as investment_structure_level_01,
		spif.investmentstructurelevel2 as investment_structure_level_02,
		uppcc.epm_party_name as ultimate_parent_party_name,
		pcc.epm_party_name as issuer_name,
		lt.parent_security_type_name /*as "Exposure Via"*/,
		lt.security_type_name,
		lt.security_name,
		sum( lt.total_market_value_pc ) as total_market_value_pc
	from (
		select *
		from 
			holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough
		where
			id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion until fix is implemented in LT product; reference Teams chat with Doug
			and id_model_portfolio not in ( -- Doug says these are test MPs that should be excluded
				  'MIN1000042'
				, 'NPTESTA'
				, 'NPTESTB'
				, 'PMIEMELTCS'
				, 'PMIEMFLTCL'
				, 'PMIEMFLTPA'
				, 'PMIEMFLTVA'
			) 
			and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough ) -- filter only for the data as of the latest business date
	) lt
	left join asset.enterprise_security /*cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_security_composite*/ secc
	on
		lt.enterprise_security_id = secc.enterprise_security_id
		and lt.business_date = secc.business_date
	left join party.enterprise_party /*cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite*/ pcc
	on
		secc.enterprise_party_id = pcc.enterprise_party_id
		and pcc.business_date = secc.business_date
	left join party.enterprise_party /*cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite*/ uppcc
	on
		pcc.ultimate_parent_enterprise_party_id = uppcc.enterprise_party_id
		and uppcc.business_date = pcc.business_date
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
	on
		lt.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	group by
		lt.business_date,
		spif.investmentstructurelevel1,
		spif.investmentstructurelevel2,
		uppcc.epm_party_name,
		pcc.epm_party_name,
		lt.parent_security_type_name,
		lt.security_type_name,
		lt.security_name
), lt_final as (
	select
		  *
		, coalesce( ultimate_parent_party_name, '' ) || ' | ' || coalesce( issuer_name, '' ) || ' | ' || coalesce( security_name, '' ) as combined_entity_name_original
		, coalesce( ultimate_parent_party_name, '' ) || ' | ' || coalesce( issuer_name, '' ) || ' | ' || coalesce( security_name_clean, '' ) as combined_entity_name_clean
		, case
			when investment_structure_level_01 in ( 'Cash for benefits', 'Accounts' ) then '7. Cash for Benefits and Residual Cash'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Total Fund Management' then '1. Total Fund Management'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Capital Markets & Factor Investing' then '2. Capital Markets & Factor Investing'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Active Equities' then '3. Active Equities'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Credit Investments' then '4. Credit Investments'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Private Equity' then '5. Private Equity'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Real Assets' then '6. Real Assets'
	  	  end department_sorted
	from (
		select
			  *
			, case
				when regexp_like( lower( security_type_name ), '.*\b(leg|swap|swaptions|option|future|contract|deposit|paper|collateralized|bond|repo|revrepo|buyselback|selbuyback)\b.*' ) then regexp_replace( security_name, '[0-9]', '' )
				else security_name
			  end security_name_clean
		from 
			lt_base
	)
)
select * from lt_final) AS "holdings_search_holdings_lookthrough"

/* cppi::68ddc5c36cd60d807b893502e3d2b324fd5c2d5baa22fec890e422a5de78a84c */
WITH statestreet_identifiers AS (
    SELECT
        ss.asset_id as asset_id,
        ss.sedol AS ss_sedol,
        ss.isin AS ss_isin,
        COALESCE(si1.cppib_sec_id, si2.cppib_sec_id, si3.cppib_sec_id) AS cppib_sec_id,
        COALESCE(si1.cusip, si2.cusip, si3.cusip, ss.asset_id) AS cusip, -- Defaults to asset_id
        COALESCE(si1.sedol, si2.sedol, si3.sedol) AS si_sedol,
        COALESCE(si1.isin, si2.isin, si3.isin) AS si_isin,
        COALESCE(si1.bloomberg_unique_id, si2.bloomberg_unique_id, si3.bloomberg_unique_id) AS bloomberg_unique_id,
        COALESCE(si1.sec_typ_lvl1_nm, si2.sec_typ_lvl1_nm, si3.sec_typ_lvl1_nm) AS sec_typ_lvl1_nm,
        COALESCE(si1.sec_nm, si2.sec_nm, si3.sec_nm) AS securityName,
        ss.bus_date
    FROM asset.statestreet_custody_security_identifiers ss
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers_universe si1
        ON ss.sedol = si1.sedol
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers_universe si2
        ON ss.asset_id = si2.cusip
        AND ss.sedol <> si1.sedol -- Only join on CUSIP if SEDOL didn't match
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers_universe si3
        ON ss.isin = si3.isin
        AND ss.sedol <> si1.sedol
        AND ss.asset_id <> si2.cusip -- Only join on ISIN if neither SEDOL nor CUSIP matched
    WHERE ss.bus_date = date_parse('2025-06-20', '%Y-%m-%d')
        AND COALESCE(si1.bloomberg_unique_id, si2.bloomberg_unique_id, si3.bloomberg_unique_id) IS NOT NULL
        AND si1.del_dt IS NULL
        AND si2.del_dt IS NULL
        AND si3.del_dt IS NULL
),

equities AS (
    SELECT
        aeu.bloomberg_primary_listing_exchange_flag,
        equity.*
    FROM statestreet_identifiers equity
    JOIN asset.asset_equity_universe aeu
        ON equity.cppib_sec_id = aeu.cppib_sec_id
    WHERE aeu.bloomberg_primary_listing_exchange_flag = 'Y'
),

bonds AS (
    SELECT
        '' AS bloomberg_primary_listing_exchange_flag,
        bond.*
    FROM statestreet_identifiers bond
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM equities eq
        WHERE eq.asset_id = bond.asset_id
    )
),

identifiers AS (
    SELECT * FROM equities
    UNION
    SELECT * FROM bonds
),

custody_holdings AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        asset_id as asset_id,
        invest_type_cd AS security_type_code
    FROM df_trusted_prod.statestreet_custody_holdings
    WHERE bus_date = date_parse('2025-06-20', '%Y-%m-%d')
),

security_details AS (
    SELECT
        t.cppib_sec_id,

        CASE
            WHEN t.sec_typ_lvl1_nm = 'Bond' THEN ab.bloomberg_ticker_and_exchange
            WHEN t.sec_typ_lvl1_nm = 'Equity' THEN ae.bloomberg_ticker_and_exchange
            WHEN t.sec_typ_lvl1_nm = 'Money market' THEN amm.bloomberg_ticker_and_exchange
            WHEN t.sec_typ_lvl1_nm = 'Entitlement' THEN aw.bloomberg_ticker_and_exchange
            ELSE NULL
        END AS ticker_exchange,

        CASE
            WHEN t.sec_typ_lvl1_nm = 'Bond' THEN ab.issue_country_iso

    from radar_reporting_prod.mv_dim_hierarchy_node_risk

)
select distinct 
	'trs_trades' as table_name, 
	underlying_instrument_name as instrument_name,
	trade_id as id_parent_position,
	id_instrument,
	m.id_model_portfolio,
	node.investment_dept,
	node.investment_strat,
	node.program,
	node.sub_program,
	node.model_portfolio,
	market_value,
	fx_rate_quoted_in_cad,
	(case returnleg_leg_type 
		when 'paying' then -1
			else 1 
		END 
		* current_price *
		case current_quantity 
		when null then 0
			else current_quantity
		END
	) as pv,
	current_quantity as quantity,
	current_price as current_price,
	'' as current_price_currency,
	0 as variation_margin,
	'' as quoted_currency_code,
	'' as unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code,
	cast(final_fixing_date as varchar) as final_fixing_date,
	returnleg_leg_type as returnleg_leg_type,
	returnleg_original_currency as returnleg_original_currency,
	(case returnleg_leg_type 
		when 'paying' then -1
			else 1 
		END 
		* current_price *
		case current_quantity 
		when null then 0
			else current_quantity
		END

	 as pv_fx,

	future_cash_flows as future_cash_flows,

	cast(trade_date as varchar) as trade_date,

	(case returnleg_leg_type 
		when 'paying' then -1
			else 1

		* current_price *

		when null then 0
			else current_quantity

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			wafprodcloudformationstac_ispj5m.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 23
		AND hour between 19 and 20
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-23 19:05:24'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

        FROM (

			    date,
			    MAX(currencyToUsdRate) OVER (
				    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
				    grouped_usd,
				    data_diff
			    ) as currencyToUsdRate,
                MAX(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
                    grouped_cad,
                    data_diff
                ) as currencyToCadRate
			FROM (
				SELECT date,
					currencyCode,
					currencyToCadRate,
					currencyToUsdRate,
					COUNT(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as grouped_cad,
					COUNT(currencyToUsdRate) OVER (
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date

					date - LAG(date, 3) OVER(
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as data_diff

						SELECT erc.data_date AS date,

								erc.exchange_rate AS currencyToCadRate,
								erd.exchange_rate AS currencyToUsdRate,
								erc.is_exchange_holiday_flag as holiday_flag

 end AS "Parent_Security_Type_Name"

,brk.party_name as "Broker_Name"

,DATE_DIFF('day',l.business_date,date(substr(m.abor_maturity_date,1,11))) AS "Term_To_Maturity"
/*Leg no but need the logic to map*/ 
,CASE 
WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSEQ','TRSEQIC') AND l.leg_no <> 2 THEN 'Equity' 
WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSEQ','TRSEQIC') AND l.leg_no = 2 THEN 'Financing' 
WHEN m.abor_security_type_id = 'IRS IR' THEN
    case when esmv.esm_sec_subtype ='Swap fixed leg' then 'Fixed' else 'Floating' end
WHEN m.abor_security_type_id = 'CDS' AND l.leg_no = 1 THEN 'Credit' 
WHEN m.abor_security_type_id = 'CDS' AND l.leg_no = 2 THEN 'Financing' 
WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FXSPOT','FXFORWARD','FXNDF')
AND l.leg_no = 1 THEN 'Base' 
WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FXSPOT','FXFORWARD','FXNDF') AND l.leg_no = 2 THEN 'Price'
WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSFIIC') AND l.leg_no <> 2 THEN 'Fixed Income'
WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSFIIC') AND l.leg_no = 2 THEN 'Financing' 
WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FUT_BOND','FUT_EQT','FUT_IR') AND l.leg_no <> 2 THEN 'Future'
WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FUT_BOND','FUT_EQT','FUT_IR') AND l.leg_no = 2 THEN 'Future Offset' 
ELSE NULL END AS Leg_Type

,CASE 
  --IRS
  WHEN m.abor_security_type_id='IRS IR' AND esmv.esm_sec_subtype ='Swap fixed leg' AND l.leg_no = 1 THEN 'Long' 
  WHEN m.abor_security_type_id='IRS IR' AND esmv.esm_sec_subtype ='Swap floating leg' AND l.leg_no = 2 THEN 'Long' 
  WHEN m.abor_security_type_id='IRS IR' AND esmv.esm_sec_subtype ='Swap floating leg' AND l.leg_no = 1 THEN 'Short'
  WHEN m.abor_security_type_id='IRS IR' AND esmv.esm_sec_subtype ='Swap fixed leg' AND l.leg_no = 2 THEN 'Short'
  /*
  WHEN m.abor_security_type_id='IRS IR' AND esmv.esm_coupon_type = 'Fixed' AND l.total_market_value_pc < 0 THEN 'Short'
  WHEN m.abor_security_type_id='IRS IR' AND esmv.esm_coupon_type = 'Fixed' AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Long' 
  WHEN m.abor_security_type_id='IRS IR' AND esmv.esm_coupon_type = 'Floating' AND l.total_market_value_pc < 0 THEN 'Long' 
  WHEN m.abor_security_type_id='IRS IR' AND esmv.esm_coupon_type = 'Floating' AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Short'
  */
  --Others
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSEQ', 'TRSEQIC') AND l.leg_no = 2 AND l.total_market_value_pc < 0 THEN 'Long'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSEQ', 'TRSEQIC') AND l.leg_no = 2 AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Short'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSEQ', 'TRSEQIC') AND l.leg_no = 1 AND l.total_market_value_pc < 0 THEN 'Short'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSEQ', 'TRSEQIC') AND l.leg_no = 1 AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Long'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('CDS') AND l.leg_no = 2 AND l.total_market_value_pc < 0 THEN 'Short'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('CDS') AND l.leg_no = 2 AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Long' 
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('CDS') AND l.leg_no = 1 AND l.total_market_value_pc < 0 THEN 'Long'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('CDS') AND l.leg_no = 1 AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Short'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FXSPOT', 'FXFORWARD', 'FXNDF') AND l.leg_no = 2 AND l.total_market_value_pc < 0 THEN 'Long'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FXSPOT', 'FXFORWARD', 'FXNDF') AND l.leg_no = 2 AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Short'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FXSPOT', 'FXFORWARD',  'FXNDF') AND l.leg_no = 1 AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Long'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FXSPOT', 'FXFORWARD',  'FXNDF') AND l.leg_no = 1 AND l.total_market_value_pc < 0 THEN 'Short'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSFIIC') AND l.leg_no = 2 AND l.total_market_value_pc < 0 THEN 'Long'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSFIIC') AND l.leg_no = 2 AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Short'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSFIIC') AND l.leg_no = 1 AND l.total_market_value_pc < 0 THEN 'Short'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSFIIC') AND l.leg_no = 1 AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Long'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FUT_BOND', 'FUT_EQT', 'FUT_IR') AND l.leg_no = 2 AND l.total_market_value_pc < 0 THEN 'Long'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FUT_BOND', 'FUT_EQT', 'FUT_IR') AND l.leg_no = 2 AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Short'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FUT_BOND', 'FUT_EQT', 'FUT_IR') AND l.leg_no = 1 AND l.total_market_value_pc < 0 THEN 'Short'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FUT_BOND', 'FUT_EQT', 'FUT_IR') AND l.leg_no = 1 AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Long'
    ELSE NULL
END AS "Contract_Direction"

,CASE WHEN l.total_market_value_pc < 0 THEN 'Short' WHEN l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Long'
      ELSE NULL END AS "Leg_Direction"
,l.underlying_index_name AS "Underlying_Index"

,case when m.abor_security_type_id='IRS IR' then concat(l.parent_security_number,'_1L0',cast(l.leg_no as varchar))
      when m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSEQIC') AND l.leg_no = 1 THEN concat('CPP',cast(esmv.cppib_sec_id as varchar))
      when m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSEQIC') AND l.leg_no = 2 THEN concat('CPP',cast(ai2.cppib_sec_id as varchar))
      when m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSFIIC') AND l.holding_level = 'Look Through' THEN
               concat('CPP',coalesce(cast(esmv.cppib_sec_id as varchar),cast(ai2.cppib_sec_id as varchar)))
      when m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSFIIC') AND l.holding_level != 'Look Through' THEN l.parent_security_number
      when m.abor_security_type_id='CDS' AND l.leg_no = 1 AND l.cppib_sec_id != 'Not Applicable' THEN concat('CPP',l.cppib_sec_id)
      when m.abor_security_type_id='CDS' AND l.leg_no = 2 THEN concat(l.parent_security_number,'-999')
      WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FXSPOT', 'FXFORWARD', 'FXNDF') AND l.leg_no = 2 THEN concat(esmv.abor_security_number,'-999')
      WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FUT_BOND','FUT_EQT','FUT_IR') AND l.leg_no = 2 THEN concat(esmv.abor_security_number,'-999')
      when m.abor_security_type_name='Equity Future' then concat('CPP',cast(esmv.cppib_sec_id as varchar))
      else coalesce(esmv.abor_security_number, concat('CPP',coalesce(cast(ai2.cppib_sec_id as varchar), cast(esmv.cppib_sec_id as varchar))))
 end AS "Underlying_Security_No"

,case WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FUT_BOND','FUT_EQT','FUT_IR') AND l.leg_no = 2 THEN concat(esmv.esm_security_name,'-FutureOffset')
      else esmv.esm_security_name
 end AS "Underlying_Security_Name"

,case when m.abor_security_type_name in ('Bond Future','Equity Future') then p.party_name

      when m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSFIIC') then coalesce(p.party_name, spi.party_name)
      else pc.epm_party_name end AS "Underlying_Issuer_Name"

,m.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency AS "FX_Rate"
,l.balance_nominal "Balance_Nominal"
,CASE WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN (
        'TRSEQ',
        'TRSEQIC',
        'CDS',
        'FXSPOT',
        'FXFORWARD',
        'FXNDF',
        'TRSFIIC',
        'FUT_BOND',
        'FUT_EQT',
        'FUT_IR',
        'IRS IR'
    )
     THEN l.total_market_value_pc 
     ELSE 0 END AS Leg_Exposure_PC 
,case when m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSEQIC','TRSFIIC','IRS IR','FUT_IR','FUT_BOND','FUT_EQT')
        then coalesce(l.currency_of_exposure_code, l.parent_quoted_currency_code)

,p.cppib_party_id ID_CPPIBPRTY_ISSR
,m.abor_security_type_name Parent_Security_Type_Name_SCD
,rs.abor_instrument_type_id Parent_Instrument_Type_Name

left join holdings.scd_holdings_main m

from holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough_extended l
left join holdings.scd_holdings_main m 
  on date(m.business_date)=l.business_date 
  and scd_holding_key_id=parent_holding_key
left join reference.scd_securities rs
  on rs.business_date=(select max(business_date) from reference.scd_securities)
  and rs.abor_security_number = m.abor_security_number
left join reference.scd_securities undrs
  on rs.abor_underlying_instrument_id = undrs.scd_security_key_id
  and rs.business_date = undrs.business_date
left join cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_security_composite esmv
  on esmv.business_date=l.business_date
  and l.enterprise_security_id = esmv.enterprise_security_id
left join cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_security_composite esmvp
  on esmvp.business_date=l.business_date
  and l.parent_cppib_sec_id = cast(esmvp.cppib_sec_id as varchar)
left join cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_security_composite und_esmv
  on und_esmv.business_date=l.business_date
  and und_esmv.abor_security_number = undrs.abor_security_number
left join cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite pc
  on l.business_date = pc.business_date
  and l.enterprise_party_id = pc.enterprise_party_id
left join asset.asset_security_identifiers ai1
  on ai1.business_date=l.business_date
  and cast(ai1.cppib_sec_id as varchar)=l.cppib_sec_id
left join asset.asset_security_identifiers ai2
  on ai2.business_date=l.business_date
  and ai2.scd_id = l.Parent_Security_Name
left join party.party_gics_classifications pgc
  on pgc.business_date=l.business_date
  and cast(pgc.cppib_party_id as varchar) = l.cppib_party_id
  and pgc.level=1
left join party.party p
  on p.business_date=l.business_date
  and cast(p.cppib_party_id as varchar) = l.cppib_party_id
left join party.party pp
  on pp.business_date=l.business_date
  and cast(pp.cppib_party_id as varchar) = esmvp.cppib_party_id
left join risk_prod.cppib_party_rating pr
  on date(pr.business_date)=l.business_date and pr.rating_agency= 'CPPIB'
  and l.cppib_party_id=cast(pr.cppib_party_id as varchar)
left join performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten pf
  on date(pf.business_date)=l.business_date
  and pf.model_portfolio = l.id_model_portfolio
  and pf.InvestmentStructure = (select max(distinct InvestmentStructure)
                                   from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten 
                                   where business_date = '2025-06-20'
                                   and InvestmentStructure like 'CPPIB_F%')
left join reference.reference_country_codes rcc
  on rcc.business_date=l.business_date
  and l.country_of_exposure_code = rcc.country_code
left join reference.scd_model_portfolio rmp
  on date(rmp.business_date)=l.business_date
  and rmp.model_portfolio_id = l.id_model_portfolio
left join reference.scd_party_issuer brk
  on date(brk.business_date)=l.business_date
  and brk.party_id = l.broker_code
  and brk.broker = 'Yes'
left join reference.scd_party_issuer spi
  on date(spi.business_date)=l.business_date
  and spi.party_id = rs.abor_issuer_id

/* cppi::67e94c604967e31bb57f38e88db00ac73db7e8ab50189717f0757204ae31f92d */
WITH analytic_pv AS
    (select sd.business_date, analytic_value
     from radar_reporting_dev
    .fact_analytic_sd sd
    join radar_reporting_dev.dim_hierarchy_node dh
on sd.dim_hierarchy_node_id = dh.dim_hierarchy_node_id and dh.node_level=2 and dh.node_name ='ACPP'
    and sd.business_date = dh.business_date
where analytic_type = 'PV'
  and portfolio_type = 'TOTAL_FUND_BY_ACCOUNT'
  and sd.business_date = '2025-06-20'
    )
select ule.gics_sector,
       sum(f.acpp_credit_exposure)                                      as credit_exposure,
       pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * max(ule.acpp_sector_conc_board_limit) as conc_sector_limit,
       case
           when max(ule.acpp_sector_conc_board_limit) > 0 then round(sum(f.acpp_credit_exposure) /
                                                                     (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * max(ule.acpp_sector_conc_board_limit)) *
                                                                     100, 2)
           else 0 end as usage,
    CASE
        WHEN sum(f.acpp_credit_exposure) / (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * max(ule.acpp_sector_conc_board_limit)) BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.949999999
            THEN 'Yellow Alert'
        WHEN sum(f.acpp_credit_exposure) / (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * max(ule.acpp_sector_conc_board_limit)) BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.999999999
            THEN 'Orange Alert'
        WHEN sum(f.acpp_credit_exposure) >= (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * max(ule.acpp_sector_conc_board_limit))
            THEN 'Breach'
        ELSE 'OK'
END
AS status

from radar_reporting_dev.fact_cr_exposure f

         join radar_reporting_dev.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity ule on le.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = ule.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id and ule.gics_sector='Financials' and f.business_date = ule.business_date
         --and ule.acpp_sector_conc_board_limit is not null-- and ule.acpp_sector_conc_board_limit != -1

         left join analytic_pv pv on f.business_date = pv.business_date
where f.acpp_credit_exposure is not null

group by ule.gics_sector, pv.analytic_value
order by sum(acpp_credit_exposure) desc

with old_breached_records as (

    from "risk_prod"."limit_utilization"
    where is_breach = 'N'
    group by limit_name,

        min(business_date) first_breach_date
    from "risk_prod"."limit_utilization"
    where is_breach = 'Y'
        and limit_id not in (
            select limit_id
            from old_breached_records
        )
    group by limit_name,

    select *
    from old_breached_records
    union all
